customManagers.description: Annotated pins in the cluster dirs: Flux postBuild *_VERSION substitutes, OCIRepository ref.tag and Kustomization images[].newTag, and container image: <dep>:<version> lines, each followed by `# datasource=<ds> depName=<dep>` on the same line. Same convention as stuttgart-things/stuttgart-things. Nothing may stand between value and annotation -- an unmatched pin is not an error, it is silence. Helm charts add `registryUrl=<repo>`.
Track both edge Flux repo pins without modifying generated YAML just to add annotations. ClusterApps lists url before tag; the generated OCIRepository lists ref.tag before url.

packageRules.description: Keep the edge ClusterApps input and generated OCIRepository pin together in one reviewed promotion.
